  Daughters
  Sons                    Child/Boy

  People                  Girl

# Prepositions Transition Statements

  ---------------------------- ------ ---------------------------- --
  THE                                 If
  And/but/also                        But/Except

  Is Not / Are Not / Nothing          (neg particle) no, not
  Also/Even                           (poetic) no, never
  Behold/If                           (neg particle) no, not
  Behold/Look                         now, after all, at last
  There is/There are                  continually
  Alone/By Oneself                    thus, here
  Around/About                        so, thus
  then, since                         again, still, as long as
  also, indeed, even                  here
  lest, otherwise                     only
  On behalf of / above         υπερ   opposite, in front of
                                      there, then, at that time
